# Raptr

> AI agents anyone can use. Three free, read-only MCP servers: build a single-file AI agent from an idea and run it on the user's data, find one of about 1,700 ready-made agents, or get verified world numbers with a public SHA-256 fingerprint. No account, no API key, nothing stored.

## MCP servers (streamable HTTP, no auth)

- [Raptr Agent Builder](https://airaptr-api.azurewebsites.net/mcp): get_agent_template, check_agent, use_agent_here, find_agents, get_agent_code, share_agent, how_to_run_agent, rejection_rescue_preview
- [Raptr Agent Finder](https://airaptr-api.azurewebsites.net/finder/mcp): find_agents, get_agent_code, use_agent_here, how_to_run_agent
- [DOGG World Check](https://airaptr-api.azurewebsites.net/world/mcp): world_now, fingerprint_text
- [Raptr Domains](https://airaptr-api.azurewebsites.net/domains/mcp): check_domain, register_domain

## Pay per call (x402 v2, USDC)

- GET https://airaptr-api.azurewebsites.net/x402/world: fresh verified world snapshot, $0.001
- POST https://airaptr-api.azurewebsites.net/x402/domains/register?domain=NAME: register an available domain; the 402 response quotes the price; charged only if registration succeeds (raise your x402 client's default $1 per-payment cap first)

## Store

- [Catalog](https://airaptr-api.azurewebsites.net/store.json): every product with its free part, paid part, price, network, exact calls, a sample input and output, and terms. Charged only when the paid output is delivered.
- Rejection Rescue, free preview: POST https://airaptr-api.azurewebsites.net/rescue/preview with {"text": "<Apple's rejection message>"}, or the MCP tool rejection_rescue_preview on https://airaptr-api.azurewebsites.net/mcp. Returns the guideline sections it recognizes and what Apple means by each.
- Rejection Rescue, full (paid): POST https://airaptr-api.azurewebsites.net/x402/rescue with {"text": "...", "changes": "optional", "recording_url": "optional"}: likely causes, a fix list and a reply draft to App Review. Price and network are in the 402 response and in store.json. Input up to 20 KB; empty, invalid or unrecognized input is refused before payment.
- Every Rejection Rescue response carries sha256, a receipt of its own body (canonical JSON).
- Coming soon: rapple-sim (free iOS Simulator MCP server), and a "Will it pass?" App Store listing check.

## A2A

- [Agent card](https://airaptr-api.azurewebsites.net/.well-known/agent-card.json): JSON-RPC message/send at https://airaptr-api.azurewebsites.net/a2a. Skills: find_agents, world_now, agent_template, rejection_rescue_preview.
